label: Subramanian 2006
setting: low vision clinics (Manchester Royal Eye Hospital; UMIST low vision clinic)
diagnosis_mix: bilateral ARM 76.2% (n=32); bilateral idiopathic optic atrophy 9.6% (n=4); bilateral ARM with glaucoma 4.7% (n=2); bilateral diabetic retinopathy 4.7% (n=2); bilateral macular holes 2.4% (n=1); bilateral resolved cystoid macular edema 2.4% (n=1)
recruitment: visually impaired attenders of two low vision clinics, some referred and some self-referred; better-eye VA 6/6-6/60 and poorer eye no better than 6/9.5; excluded if in hospital/nursing home, non-English speaking, or MMBlind <17/22; sampling method and dates NR
notes: Questionnaire development/Rasch validation plus correlation with vision tests; no accuracy analysis. 42 took part, 40 completed all experiments (p2); n_items 28 after Rasch reduction from 30 (p3) but text later says 26-item (p3); 15 min is an upper bound ("no more than 15 minutes", p3); median age NR; ages given as range 36-89 +/- 12.5 SD; pct_glaucoma = 2 of 42 with ARM plus glaucoma (p3); VA = ETDRS best-corrected binocular 0.47 +/- 0.30 logMAR; visual fields not measured (p2)
